# x402-recurring

> Standing orders for agents: mandate documents plus a client-side scheduler that pays per run and collects run reports

x402-recurring is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-recurring/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
